columns.name: whatsapp
columns.label: WhatsApp number
columns.help: International format, e.g. +971501234567. Shown as a chat button on every page.

columns.name: trn
columns.label: VAT TRN
columns.help: Your 15-digit Tax Registration Number. When set, receipts become tax invoices.

columns.name: licence
columns.label: Licence
columns.help: E.g. DET trade licence 1234567. Shown in the footer and on invoices.

columns.name: deposit_percent
columns.label: Default deposit (%)
columns.help: Share of the total asked when a quote is accepted, e.g. 50. A quote can set its own.

columns.name: quote_valid_days
columns.label: Quote validity (days)
columns.help: How long a quote can be accepted when it has no valid-until date of its own.

columns.name: card_enabled
columns.label: Card payments
columns.help: Needs Stripe connected in Renoxium, Payments.

columns.name: bank_details
columns.label: Bank transfer details
columns.help: Bank, account name and IBAN, shown to a client who chooses bank transfer. Leave empty to turn transfers off.

columns.name: prices_include_vat
columns.label: Quote prices include VAT
columns.help: Off (usual for business clients): 5% VAT is added on top of the quote lines. On: the line prices already include VAT.

columns.name: category
columns.label: Category
columns.help: Packages with the same category are shown together on the home page.

columns.name: price_from
columns.label: Price from (AED)
columns.help: Shown as "From AED ...". Leave empty to show "Price on request".

columns.name: included
columns.label: What is included
columns.help: One item per line.

columns.name: included_ar
columns.label: What is included (Arabic)
columns.help: One item per line.

columns.name: duration
columns.label: Typical duration
columns.help: E.g. 2 to 3 weeks.

columns.name: user_id
columns.label: Client account
columns.help: Set by the site. The client with this account sees the quotes of this enquiry.

columns.name: email
columns.help: Quotes, updates and receipts are emailed here.

columns.name: package_id
columns.label: Package number
columns.help: Empty for a free-form enquiry.

columns.name: enquiry_id
columns.label: Enquiry number
columns.help: The number (id) of the enquiry this quote answers. The client who sent that enquiry sees the quote.

columns.name: title
columns.label: Title
columns.help: E.g. Mainland LLC setup for Al Reem Trading.

columns.name: lines
columns.label: Lines
columns.help: One entry per line of the quote: [{"name": "Service fee", "qty": 1, "price": 1500}, {"name": "Government fees", "qty": 1, "price": 3200}]. Prices in AED; qty can be left out (1). Changes after the client accepted do not change the accepted quote.

columns.name: deposit_percent
columns.label: Deposit (%)
columns.help: Leave empty to use the default from Business settings. 0 = no deposit, 100 = full payment up front.

columns.name: valid_until
columns.label: Valid until
columns.help: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-12-31. Leave empty to count the validity days of Business settings from the day the client is told.

columns.name: status
columns.label: Status
columns.help: draft: only you see it. sent: the client sees it and is emailed right away. The other values are set by the site; choose cancelled to withdraw a quote.

columns.name: balance_due
columns.label: Ask for the balance
columns.help: Tick when the work is done (or any time): the client can then pay the balance and is emailed.

columns.name: notified
columns.label: Client told about the quote
columns.help: Ticked by the site after the email. Untick to send the email again.

columns.name: balance_notified
columns.label: Client told about the balance
columns.help: Ticked by the site after the email.

columns.name: accepted_at
columns.label: Accepted at (UTC)
columns.help: Filled in when the client accepts.

columns.name: accepted_lines
columns.label: Lines as accepted
columns.help: Copy of the lines at the moment the client accepted. Do not change.

columns.name: subtotal
columns.label: Total before VAT (AED)
columns.help: Stored when the client accepts.

columns.name: paid_amount
columns.label: Paid so far (AED)
columns.help: Kept up to date from the Payments table.

columns.name: status
columns.label: Status
columns.help: For a bank transfer: choose paid once the money is in your account. Card payments are updated by the site.

columns.name: reference
columns.help: For a transfer: what the client was asked to write on the transfer.

columns.name: paid_at
columns.label: Paid at (UTC)
columns.help: Filled in by the site.

columns.name: notified
columns.label: Receipt emailed
columns.help: Ticked by the site after the receipt email.

columns.name: title
columns.label: Title
columns.help: E.g. Trade licence issued.

columns.name: link
columns.label: Link
columns.help: Optional, starting with https://, e.g. a shared folder with documents or photos.

columns.name: notified
columns.label: Client emailed
columns.help: Ticked by the site after the email.

columns.name: user_id
columns.label: Client account
columns.help: Empty for your own replies.

columns.name: sender
columns.label: From
columns.help: To reply to a client, add a row with From = firm.

columns.name: notified
columns.label: Client emailed
columns.help: Ticked by the site after your reply was emailed.

texts.en: Choose a service or describe your case. It takes two minutes.
texts.ar: اختر خدمة أو صف حالتك. لا يستغرق ذلك أكثر من دقيقتين.

texts.en: We send a quote with every line and VAT, usually within one working day.
texts.ar: نرسل عرض سعر بكل البنود والضريبة، عادةً خلال يوم عمل واحد.

texts.en: Accept online and pay the deposit by card or bank transfer.
texts.ar: وافق عبر الموقع وادفع الدفعة المقدمة بالبطاقة أو بالتحويل المصرفي.

texts.en: See each step in your portal and pay the balance when the work is done.
texts.ar: تابع كل خطوة في بوابتك وادفع المبلغ المتبقي عند إنجاز العمل.

texts.en: Describe what you need and we will send you a quote.
texts.ar: صف لنا ما تحتاجه وسنرسل لك عرض سعر.

texts.en: Sign in to send your enquiry and follow your quote.
texts.ar: سجّل الدخول لإرسال طلبك ومتابعة عرض السعر.

texts.en: Activity, number of partners and visas, anything we should know
texts.ar: النشاط وعدد الشركاء والتأشيرات وأي معلومات مهمة

texts.en: We reply with a written quote in your portal and by email.
texts.ar: سنرد بعرض سعر مكتوب في بوابتك وعبر البريد الإلكتروني.

texts.en: This quote is being updated. Please check again shortly or send us a message.
texts.ar: يتم تحديث عرض السعر حالياً. يرجى المحاولة بعد قليل أو مراسلتنا.
الأسعار أعلاه شاملة ضريبة القيمة المضافة.

texts.en: I accept this quote and its terms on behalf of myself or my company.
texts.ar: أوافق على عرض السعر وشروطه بالأصالة عن نفسي أو نيابةً عن شركتي.

texts.en: We will ask for the balance when the work is done.
texts.ar: سنطلب المبلغ المتبقي عند إنجاز العمل.

texts.en: I will pay by bank transfer
The card payment did not go through. You can try again.
texts.ar: لم تكتمل عملية الدفع بالبطاقة. يمكنك المحاولة مرة أخرى.

texts.en: Your payment is being confirmed. This page will show it in a moment.
texts.ar: جارٍ تأكيد الدفع. سيظهر في هذه الصفحة بعد لحظات.

texts.en: Please transfer the amount below and write the reference on the transfer. We confirm it here once it arrives.
texts.ar: يرجى تحويل المبلغ أدناه وكتابة المرجع في التحويل. سنؤكد الاستلام هنا عند وصوله.

texts.en: To send documents, share a link here or send them on WhatsApp.
texts.ar: لإرسال المستندات، شارك رابطاً هنا أو أرسلها عبر واتساب.

texts.en: Thank you. We received your enquiry and will send your quote here.
texts.ar: شكراً لك. استلمنا طلبك وسنرسل عرض السعر هنا.

texts.en: Thank you. Your acceptance is recorded.
The quote is declined. Tell us what to change and we will send a new one.
texts.ar: تم رفض العرض. أخبرنا بما تريد تغييره وسنرسل عرضاً جديداً.

texts.en: Thank you. The bank details are below.
texts.ar: شكراً لك. تفاصيل الحساب المصرفي أدناه.

texts.en: Thank you. We received your payment.
Please enter your name, your phone and a service or a message.
texts.ar: يرجى إدخال الاسم ورقم الهاتف واختيار خدمة أو كتابة رسالة.

texts.en: You sent several enquiries today. Please message us on WhatsApp.
texts.ar: أرسلت عدة طلبات اليوم. يرجى مراسلتنا عبر واتساب.

texts.en: Please type your name and tick the box to accept.
texts.ar: يرجى كتابة اسمك ووضع علامة في المربع للموافقة.

texts.en: This quote has expired. Send us a message and we will renew it.
texts.ar: انتهت صلاحية هذا العرض. راسلنا وسنجدده.

texts.en: This quote can no longer be answered.
texts.ar: لم يعد من الممكن الرد على هذا العرض.

texts.en: This is not possible right now. Please send us a message.
texts.ar: هذا غير ممكن حالياً. يرجى مراسلتنا.

texts.en: This payment method is not available right now. Please choose another or contact us.
texts.ar: طريقة الدفع هذه غير متاحة حالياً. يرجى اختيار طريقة أخرى أو التواصل معنا.

texts.en: The balance is not due yet. We will ask for it when the work is done.
texts.ar: المبلغ المتبقي غير مستحق بعد. سنطلبه عند إنجاز العمل.

texts.en: Please write a message of at most 1000 characters.
texts.ar: يرجى كتابة رسالة لا تتجاوز 1000 حرف.

texts.en: You sent many messages today. Please call or message us on WhatsApp.
texts.ar: أرسلت رسائل كثيرة اليوم. يرجى الاتصال بنا أو مراسلتنا عبر واتساب.
